titulo.alumno:
«Причастие как определение»
The participle as an attribute

intro: The long participle accompanies a noun and agrees with it in gender, number and case: новый закон, принятый парламентом.

frases.estudio: Мы изучили документы, опубликованные на сайте.
frases.alumno: We studied the documents published on the website.

frases.estudio: Я прочитал о проекте, одобренном комиссией.
frases.alumno: I read about the project approved by the commission.

piezas.titulo: The long participle accompanies a noun and agrees with it in gender, number and case: новый закон, принятый парламентом.
texto: The long participle accompanies a noun and agrees with it in gender, number and case: новый закон, принятый парламентом.
It keeps the government of the verb: говорить о законе, принятом парламентом; also note the adjective ending.

opciones.explicacion: After о the masculine singular prepositional case is used: одобренном.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Мы изучили документы, опубликованные на сайте.»

frase.texto: Мы изучили документы, опубликованные на сайте.

opciones.texto: We studied the documents published on the website.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: I read about the project approved by the commission.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Я прочитал о проекте, одобренном комиссией

piezas.traduccion: I read about the project approved by the commission.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
